<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

Adds two constructors—NewConfigFromStringAndClusterMonitoringResource and NewConfigFromConfigMapAndClusterMonitoringResource—that accept an optional *ClusterMonitoring and are used by legacy constructors. Replaces exported MergeClusterMonitoringCRD and EnsureSafeDefaults with an unexported mergeClusterMonitoringCRD invoked during construction. Changes applyDefaults to always initialize UserWorkloadEnabled (false when nil), Prometheus collection profile (FullCollectionProfile when empty), and MetricsServerConfig/Audit defaults (initialized with Audit.Profile defaulted to metadata). ClusterMonitoring CR merging logic simplified: direct boolean assignment for user-workload and overwrite behavior for metrics-server audit fields. Operator.loadConfig now accepts and forwards the optional ClusterMonitoring CR; tests updated accordingly.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

</details>
